nodes.short_description: ¡Golpea, abofetea y machaca cabezas de arcilla blanditas en VR! Elige armas alocadas como una palanca y pistolas, observa cómo las cabezas se deforman gracias a la física soft body y escucha cómo reaccionan a cada golpe. ¡Juega a HIT, la herramienta definitiva para liberar el estrés!

Hau, schlag und watsch weiche Knetköpfe in VR! Wähle verrückte Waffen wie Brechstangen und Pistolen, sieh zu, wie sich die Köpfe dank Soft-Body-Physik verformen, und hör, wie sie auf jeden Treffer reagieren. Spiel HIT, das ultimative Stress-Abbau-Tool!

Frappez, giflez et cognez des têtes en pâte à modeler dans un jeu VR ! Choisissez des armes déjantées comme des pieds-de-biche et des pistolets, regardez les têtes se déformer grâce à la physique souple et entendez-les réagir à chaque coup. Jouez à HIT, l'outil ultime pour évacuer le stress !

¡Golpea, abofetea y azota cabezas de arcilla blanditas en VR! Elige armas alocadas como una barreta y pistolas, mira cómo las cabezas se deforman con física soft body y escúchalas reaccionar a cada golpe. ¡Juega HIT, la herramienta definitiva para liberar el estrés!
喺VR入面捶打、掌摑同痛擊軟綿綿嘅黏土人頭!揀選撬棍、槍支等瘋狂武器,睇吓啲頭喺軟體物理效果下變形,聽吓每次打擊嘅反應。即刻玩HIT,終極舒壓神器!
VRでぷにぷにの粘土頭をぶん殴ろう!バールや銃などの過激な武器を選んで、ソフトボディ物理演算で頭が変形する様子を見て、一撃ごとの反応を聞こう。究極のストレス発散ツール、HITをプレイしよう!

Esmurre, esbofeteie e acerte cabeças de argila fofinhas em VR! Escolha armas malucas como pés de cabra e armas de fogo, veja as cabeças se deformarem com física soft body e ouça-as reagir a cada golpe. Jogue HIT, a ferramenta definitiva para aliviar o estresse!

Colpisci, schiaffeggia e mena teste di argilla morbida in VR! Scegli armi folli come piedi di porco e pistole, guarda le teste deformarsi grazie alla fisica soft-body e ascoltale reagire a ogni colpo. Gioca a HIT, lo strumento definitivo per scaricare lo stress!

Smash, slap, and whack squishy clay heads in VR! Choose wild weapons like crowbars and guns, watch heads deform with soft body physics and hear the heads react to each blow. Play HIT, the ultimate stress relief tool!
在VR中捶打、扇打、猛击软乎乎的粘土人头!选择撬棍、枪械等疯狂武器,观看头部在软体物理效果下变形,聆听每次击打的反应。畅玩HIT,终极解压神器!
VR에서 말랑말랑한 점토 머리를 때리고, 후려치고, 갈겨보세요! 쇠지레와 총 같은 과격한 무기를 골라 소프트바디 물리 효과로 머리가 변형되는 모습을 보고 타격마다 반응하는 소리를 들어보세요. 궁극의 스트레스 해소 도구, HIT를 플레이하세요!

nodes.long_description:
# 👊 The Ultimate Stress-Buster!
Play HIT and take out your stress by pummelling, slapping, and whacking squishy clay heads in a VR sandbox. Thanks to our wild soft body physics, every hit deforms and reshapes the heads in hilariously unpredictable ways!  
  
{581241924916221}
  
# 🪓Choose Your Weapon  
Fists, frying pans, baseball bats—even a flopping fish!  
  
{1328852431700754}
  
# 👤30 Unique Heads to Wreck  
Each one reacts to your hits with funny voices and expressions.  
  
{980958897475587}
  
# 🏝️Chill Vibes:  
Destroy in peace, surrounded by a tranquil paradise.  
  
{1079261667549812}
  
# ⭐Development Roadmap  
**100** store reviews = **3 new weapons** added  
**1000** store reviews  =  **10 new clay models**  added (have your say on which!)  
**10000** store reviews =  **upload your own clay models feature** added  
  
# Join our Discord and tell us what to add next: https://discord.gg/ay3PfTKzw3

{605877485686349}
